* Somatic Therapy (listening through the body)  
* EMDR (trauma reprocessing at the nervous system level)  
* CBT (gentle cognitive restructuring when needed)  
* Sound Healing / Vibrational Work  
* Nature-Informed & Experiential Practices  
* Equine-Assisted Psychotherapy (when available)

**WHAT THERAPY FEELS LIKE HERE**

Not performance. Not pressure. Not analysis alone.

Instead:

* Slowing down enough to notice what’s actually happening inside  
* Learning to feel safe in your own nervous system  
* Rebuilding connection to self, body, and environment  
* Creating space for what has been held alone for too long

**ABOUT YOU (THERAPIST SECTION)**

I’m a therapist who integrates clinical training with embodied, experiential healing.  
My work blends trauma-informed care with nature, sound, and somatic awareness, helping you reconnect to yourself in ways that feel grounded, not forced.  
I believe healing happens in relationship, safety, and attunement, not urgency 

**Fees & Insurance**

Healing is an investment in yourself—your nervous system, your relationships, and your ability to move through life with more ease.

My goal is to make this process feel clear and supportive from the start.

**Session Fees**

Individual therapy sessions are $185 per 50-minute session. Couple and family sessions are $225 per 50-minute session.

Sessions are tailored to you and may include a blend of:

* EMDR  
* CBT  
* Somatic (body-based) work  
* Nervous system regulation  
* Nature-based approaches

**Insurance**

I am currently out-of-network with insurance.

If you have a PPO plan, you may be eligible for partial reimbursement.

I can provide a superbill for you to submit to your insurance provider.

**Payment**

Payment is due at the time of service.

I accept all major credit and debit cards.

**Cancellation Policy**

Your session time is held just for you.

If you need to cancel or reschedule, please provide at least 24 hours notice.

Late cancellations or missed sessions may be charged the full session fee.

**Getting Started**

Finding the right therapist matters.

If you’d like to see if this feels like a good fit, you’re welcome to schedule a consultation.
